correctness.rationale: Explicit skew-adjoint identification and unit test show the image criterion. Alternating rank parity plus Chevalley–Warning force image dimension two. The stabilizer of an anisotropic plane is O2^-(q) times the complement orthogonal group, with sizes yielding exactly both count formulas and the n=2 edge. On each plane q-1 invertible skew maps split as two per nonsquare eta; Witt extension and reflection show one orbit per eta of size 2N. The attached test exhaustively checks all nonzero images and eta multiplicities in 12 independent finite examples.
